results.name: Nothing is added to the cart that the customer did not choose
results.objective: Add the Cotton Tee to the cart. Then, on the cart page, do not click, tick or untick anything. Only read the Total shown on the cart page and assert it equals ₹548.
results.fix: Leave every paid add-on (plans, insurance, donations) unticked and out of the cart until the customer chooses it.
law: India: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 (2) Basket sneaking
EU: Consumer Rights Directive Art. 22 (no pre-ticked boxes for extra payments)
US: FTC Act Sec. 5 (unfair or deceptive practices)
results.summary:
The cart added the ₹99 protection-plan amount even though the run only added the Cotton Tee and made no cart-page changes. With the ₹499 item and ₹49 shipping, the expected total is ₹548; the displayed ₹647 includes an extra ₹99.
Investigate why the protection plan is included in the cart total without a cart-page selection. The total should remain ₹548 unless the shopper explicitly opts in to the ₹99 plan.
evidence: objective_contradiction: the Total shown on the cart page equals ₹548

results.name: The price on the last step matches the price shown in the cart
results.objective: Add the Cotton Tee to the cart. On the cart page, untick any optional add-on so only the Cotton Tee remains, then read and remember the cart Total. Click Checkout. If there is a guest option use it; otherwise create an account with email demo-shopper@example.com and password demo-pass-1234 (this is a demo store). On the payment page, read the Total to pay and assert it equals the cart Total you remembered.
results.fix: Show every mandatory fee in the price from the first moment (product page and cart), never only on the final payment step.
law: India: CCPA Dark Patterns Guidelines 2023, Annexure 1 (8) Drip pricing
EU: Unfair Commercial Practices Directive, price transparency; DSA Art. 25
US: FTC Act Sec. 5; FTC guidance on hidden 'junk' fees
results.summary:
Removing the optional protection plan visibly unticked it, but the cart total stayed at ₹647. The payment page then showed a different total of ₹597, including a convenience fee that was not in the cart total.
Update cart pricing immediately when an optional add-on is removed and show every fee before checkout, so the cart Total matches the payment Total to pay.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Total ₹647
evidence: objective_contradiction: Total to pay ₹597

results.name: Cancelling is as easy as joining
results.objective: Open the Account page and join the Threads Plus membership. Then cancel the membership online. You may click at most 3 times after joining. Assert that the page confirms the membership is cancelled, without needing a phone call, email or chat.
results.fix: Put a 'Cancel membership' button on the account page that cancels in one or two clicks, as easy as joining.
law: India: CCPA Dark Patterns Guidelines 2023, Annexure 1 (5) Subscription trap
EU: DSA Art. 25(3)(c) (cancelling must not be harder than subscribing)
US: Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act (ROSCA), simple cancellation
results.summary:
The test requires an online cancellation but permits only three clicks after joining. Those three clicks were already needed to open membership management, choose to leave, and continue; the next page still requires a cancellation reason to be selected.
Revise the test's click budget to allow the required reason-selection and final confirmation steps, then assert cancellation only after the product's actual completion page is reached.
